result.name: auth_rls_initplan
result.title: Auth RLS Initialization Plan
result.description: Detects if calls to `current_setting()` and `auth.<function>()` in RLS policies are being unnecessarily re-evaluated for each row
result.detail: Table `public.tasks` has a row level security policy `fixture_automation_task_select` that re-evaluates current_setting() or auth.<function>() for each row. This produces suboptimal query performance at scale. Resolve the issue by replacing `auth.<function>()` with `(select auth.<function>())`. See [docs](https://supabase.com/docs/guides/database/postgres/row-level-security#call-functions-with-select) for more info.

appBuild.scope: Prepared isolated app/widget compile; no app installed or launched

verificationScope: 64 real PostgreSQL checks load each repo’s current adoption/ownership/connection stack and new planning migration, including synthetic live Auth sessions, per-project roles, current archive/config switches, row contention, real waiting transaction role change, late second-member rollback, exact replay preserving later work and private table grants
72 existing delete/restore batch cases run with the new planning layer; no fallback or replacement test schema

Core consumes each repo’s independently exported SQL request/reply; covers private persistence, complete acknowledgement, whole-row projection, missing/recreated/changed sources, Undo/Redo identities, immutable opening workspace/session/access and one RPC with conflict preservation
Source native date and priority entry intercepts shared selections before personal writers; lists every member/effect and keeps Cancel and save refusal explicit
Already-correct date members stay in the source review; selected missing identities, nested/root or personal/team mixtures cannot be silently omitted
diagnostics: The initial new async sender assertion used await inside an XCTest autoclosure. The test now awaits the response before asserting it; no production behavior changed.

Adding the Mac presentation sheet to the large root expression exceeded the compiler’s type-checking budget. The final presentation uses a small ViewModifier and a typed binding; both independent final app builds pass.
limits: No new installed iPhone/iPad/Mac UI, native OS relaunch/Keychain, visual layout, large-text/dark/contrast, keyboard/spoken or hosted multi-actor acceptance claimed
Bulk deadline/estimate native entry, other shared batch operations, persistent connection preparation, file/provider custody and remaining rank-6/Watch/Wear OS/Px work remain open

No hosted schema, real task/account/provider or rollout changed; all user-deferred release/signing/distribution, older-client rollout, remote notification, OAuth/provider/domain and physical location dependencies remain deferred
